quote: Loved working with Fever Dream Comedy! So professional and easy to organize with. The set was great, the guests had an really fun time and we were chuffed with the overall sales and turn out. Would love to work with them again!
author: Anonymous

quote: Fever Dream has been hosting Girls Night at our cafe for over a year and it is always a blast! They put together a well run show, bring in great comics, and create an inclusive and engaging environment for their audience!
author: Whoopsie Daisy, Kitchener

quote: Fever Dream Comedy created such a fun vibe to ladies night. The set up was coordinated and smooth and the show was great. The ladies were able to finish an evening of relaxation with laughter and fun.
author: Jordan B.

quote: Fever Dream Comedy delivers a thoughtful, charming, and cozy vibe with every show and performance, while also uplifting and building their own community of hilarious comedy to the Ontario region and beyond. Hilarious people doing fantastic work!
author: Alberto B.
